description:
Returns a paginated list of purchase orders with filtering and sorting options.
Supports multiple view types: Normal (default), Short, Compact, Extended, Mobile, and Id.
Results can be filtered by associated document IDs, labels, and vendors.

parameters.description: Response view type

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The page size between 1 and 100. For Ids view the maximum page size is 5000.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description: The date range string for purchase order creation dates. Format: [YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD] (e.g. [2026-01-01...2026-12-31])
